training: All original train pairs, generated labels, excluding only invalid structural input with explicit count.
selection: All original validation pairs. Maximize total correct; ties favor fewer rules, then policy order. Abstention never counts as Neutral.
evaluation: All original test pairs, plus original reviewer/quality strata and statement-disjoint subset. Test previously consumed by the equivalence diagnostic; not a fresh M1 reserve.
limits: At most 300 seconds per process. Structural page and original capacities remain separate; no extra interpreter or Portuguese label heuristics. Three supervised search policies, not thousands of evolved brains.
acceptance: Diagnostic only. Publish all failures, wrong answers and abstentions. This experiment alone cannot approve M1 or start M2. No LLM, energy or RSS comparison.
